'''Ithor''' was a [[planet]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] that was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian]] [[species]], who spoke [[Ithorese]]. The expansive [[jungle]]s of Ithor were considered to be sacred, and [[hunting]] there was highly illegal.

==Description==
Ithor was a [[planet]]<ref name="Ithorians" /> of the [[Ottega system]]<ref name="Aliens of the Galaxy" /> located in the [[New Territories]] portion of<ref name="Explorer's Guide" /> [[the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories]], situated in the [[Ottegan sector]] in grid square M-6 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> The expansive [[jungle]]s of Ithor were considered to be sacred, and [[hunting]] there was highly illegal. Their [[Plant|flora]] included the dense [[n'lor tree]]s, the [[Diet|carnivorous]] [[johinuu tree]]s, a variety of [[Color|green]] and rust-hued bushes, and carpets of blue and pink edible [[Fungus|fungi]]. Their fauna included the rare and deadly [[molsume]], and the [[toscwon]].<ref name="Bait" />

==History==
The Ithorians, who worshipped [[Mother Jungle]], long ago vowed to keep their homeworld pristine. They moved their [[Ithorian herd|herds]] into great [[Ithorian herd ship|floating cities]] in the skies of Ithor, and eventually out into space. The planet was the center of a [[Standard year|triennial]] [[Herd Meet]], a meeting that was attended by every Ithorian herd ship.<ref name="Unlimited Power">''[[Unlimited Power]]''</ref>

At some point, the [[Republic Navy|Galactic Republic Navy]] participated in a [[Battle on Ithor|battle]] on the planet against a vicious band of [[pirate]]s who were fighting against the [[Jedi Master]] [[Oorrl Morm]]. Following Morm's sacrifice, which delayed the attacks of the pirates, a Republic Navy [[warship]] arrived and took the criminals into custody.<ref name="Nexus">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

The Ithorian [[Jho]] left Ithor to settle on the planet [[Lothal]], where he operated a [[cantina]] known as [[Old Jho's Pit Stop]].<ref name="Head to Head">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Head to Head]]''</ref> At some point, an Ithorian [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] sympathizer named [[Momaw Nadon]] was forced to reveal the secrets of Ithorian [[Farm|agricultural]] technology to the [[Galactic Empire]] to save his homeworld from destruction.<ref name="Ultimate">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Life Debt date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]].</ref> a [[New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Starfall]]'' on a diplomatic [[Mission to Ithor|mission]] to recruit Ithor to the nascent [[The galaxy|galactic]] government led by the [[Senator]] [[Tia'dor Emshwa]] was boarded by [[Eleodie Maracavanya]]'s [[Super Star Destroyer]] [[Liberty's Misrule|''Annihilator'']].<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Ithor was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian]] [[species]],<ref name="Ithorians" /> who spoke [[Ithorese]].<ref name="Aftermath" />
